text: `uv run --locked pytest tests/contract/test_ci_claims_no_more_than_it_runs.py tests/provider_contract/per_provider/test_opencode_plugin.py -q -p no:randomly`. It goes red if the marker is removed from the opencode module (the equality fails).
why: Every artifact this task changes is test infrastructure (a pytest marker registration in tests/conftest.py, a module pytestmark, and a contract test), so there is no product code to break. Shown able to fail by hand at 2026-10-08: with the pytestmark absent, test_every_node_dependent_test_carries_the_marker_and_nothing_else_does failed listing all 13 unmarked opencode-plugin tests; with it present, 19 passed.
